The '''Broken Bow Canyon''' was a canyon in the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Broken Bow Canyon appears as an area on Hoth in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
